findings.detail: UTF-8 lengths match TextEncoder replacement: ASCII1, U+0080..07FF2, other BMP3, valid high+low pair4. Lone high/low adds replacement3 and validUnicode=false; unmatched high does not consume next character, so high-high-low yields replacement3 + pair4. Code-point count matches the prior string iterator for both valid and malformed input.

Cache keys are exact immutable primitive strings. Value contains only frozen codePoints/utf8Bytes/validUnicode scalars; every caller retains its own schema limits and issue paths. Long >4096 UTF-16 unit strings are measured without caching. FIFO eviction enforces <=512 keys and <=1048576 logical UTF-16 source bytes.

1MiB is logical retained string-content length, not total heap/RSS. JavaScript map/object overhead and engine rope/sliced-string backing retention are not measured or bounded by this counter. Do not describe it as a 1MiB actual heap cap.

Regex enforces exact 10-character ASCII YYYY-MM-DD before lookup. previous!==undefined returns cached false correctly. Original Date+ISO roundtrip still runs on misses; 512 oldest keys bound logical date text. Correcting an invalid date creates a different exact key, so old false cannot suppress corrected acceptance.

Changed four model and three archive object loops skip only values that the old callees immediately returned for (falsy or typeof!==object). Arrays stay object-valued and retain the old ordered forEach recursion. Depth increment, key order for JSON objects, exclusions, visited sets, immutable snapshot hash checks and field validators are unchanged.

Object.keys followed by per-child recursion reads sibling accessors at a different time than Object.entries/values eager materialization. Plain parsed/native JSON rows have no accessors. No equivalence claim is made for adversarial getters/proxies; capture/strict JSON contracts remain the production boundary.

No native read batching, schema limits, canonical JSON encoding, content/SHA verification, unknown/required-field rules or archive caps were modified by these loops. Native/App startup improvement remains unmeasured independently.
